session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Bear Trap, Small Pullback Bull Trend From The Open'; regime note 'Then Trading Range'. Reading: open dip to 4099 became a bear trap followed by a major bull surprise and HL-MTR off the 4103 lows, drawn magenta wedge bottom broke out just before 08:30 with a measured-move-up claim; buy climax leg with a late ii carried to 4131-4134 and the afternoon held a shaded small-pullback-bull / trading range into the close. Axis prints 4/6 06:45-13:00 with 4/7 edge marker (plain-PT style).
